description.zh:
用于指向用户希望访问的资源，格式如下：```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

参数说明如下：

- regionId：地域ID，可调用[DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~)接口获取。
- accountId：阿里云账号ID，可调用[DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~)接口获取。
- instanceId：实例ID。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) that specifies the resource to access. Format: ```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

Parameter description:

- regionId: the region ID. You can call the [DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~) operation to obtain this value.
- accountId: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can call the [DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~) operation to obtain this value.
- instanceId: the instance ID.

description.zh: Data API账号的用户凭证，您可调用[DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~)接口获取该参数的值。格式如下：`acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`
description.en: The user credential of the Data API account. You can call the [DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter. Format: `acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`.

description.zh: 需要回滚的事务ID，您可调用**BeginTransaction**接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the transaction to roll back. You can call the **BeginTransaction** operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

descriptions.zh: 本接口当前仅支持华东1（杭州）、华北2（北京）地域的Serverless实例使用。
descriptions.en: This operation is supported only for Serverless instances in the China (Hangzhou) and China (Beijing) regions.
